answer: New identities lock a 300-POA escrow unlocked only by proving a human behavioral fingerprint. Across a six-epoch probation horizon the protocol samples each agent's behavioral pulse into a hash. Auditors compare prints: a river of identities echoing one copy-pasted pulse is flagged and proven sybils burn their escrow. Faking 1,000 puppets forfeits 300,000 POA, linear in N; one honest agent locks one deposit, refunded in full at the horizon's end.
